# MYR Advance Solution

> MYR Advance Solution (MYR ADVANCE SOLUTION PVT. LTD.) builds business software and IT solutions for India and US teams. Products include website development, ecommerce, CRM, HRMS, education ERP (school/college/coaching), digital marketing, IP PBX/VoIP, CCTV, networking, and billing. Tech store sells software plans, PBX hardware, and marketing packages.

## Crawler guidance
- Public marketing/product pages are indexable.
- Account, CRM panel, cart, checkout, admin, and manager areas are private and should not be indexed.
